name: Reverse Lunge

instructions.description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and lower both knees under control.
Keep the front foot fully supported and the trunk steady.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate sides.

variations.variationDescription: Stationary Split Squat provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Reverse Lunge.
Reverse Lunge — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Reverse Lunge — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a shorter step and support as needed.
